newScope: The current static Sidebar and Quick Switch states do not certify project-group hierarchy, empty project rows, project collapse/create-thread actions, or the dedicated Add Project source-selection flow.

Add Project is a nested command-palette workflow with Local folder, Git URL, provider readiness, disabled Setup Required rows, Back, and environment routing; it is not equivalent to the root palette merely containing an Add project action.
Command palette hover highlight and ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Backspace, and Escape form one interaction contract. A footer that advertises navigation without runtime handling is a product loss.
productLoss: Lynx hard-codes Sidebar V2 on every non-Settings route, bypassing the existing shared project-group composition and rendering one flat global active/settled thread list.

Lynx Sidebar Add project opens ordinary command mode, while the root Quick Switch Add project action only closes the palette. The existing shared OpenAddProject intent is therefore unreachable from both Lynx entry points.
Lynx Quick Switch rows have no highlighted index or hover/key navigation state even though the footer advertises Arrow navigation and Enter selection.
harnessMismatch: The user comparison used different persisted state and environment-identification settings for Electron and Lynxtron. The blue development artwork versus plain header cannot be classified as product loss until both clients share the same snapshot and environmentIdentificationMode.
Historical grouped Sidebar evidence proves the renderer can display project rows, but it predates the current forced V2 path and cannot certify current behavior.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Registration is denominator-only. Thirty-six new Lynx-for-Web and Native cells enter as conservative unknown. Existing quick-switch-default and existing-thread-idle evidence is preserved but does not satisfy these nested hierarchy and interaction contracts.

denominatorChange.reason: Three user-reachable P1 states were absent from the fixed denominator and cannot be represented by static Sidebar or root-palette cells.
